steps.what: Read confidentiality rules and verify current client-record access facts
Compare explicit case-access entries against established role and expiry rules
Investigate actual access exceptions and confidentiality concerns in context
Determine and check the necessary access-change request and authorized administrator recipient
Send the approved access-change request to the authorized records administrator

tasks.design: For an existing case-access review, configure native role and expiry exception filters in the clinical application in {OTHER}. Keep contextual investigation and the counselor's actual access-change request human, with its final content checked before the separate internal send in {EMAIL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reviewing confidentiality combines repeated explicit permission comparisons with contextual decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native permission reports can flag fixed role or expiry mismatches without deciding clinical access rights.
tasks.still_hard: Determining legitimate access in unusual care arrangements.
tasks.human_edge: Understand confidentiality, care relationships and the consequences of disclosure.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated permission comparison with unchanged confidentiality responsibility.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical record systems can report explicit role and access-expiry mismatches, but contextual confidentiality decisions need a responsible professional.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is an existing counselor-owned case-access review with a real administrator request, not all confidentiality work. OTHER is the clinical case application. Physical safeguarding and other confidentiality duties remain outside this scenario and receive no extrapolated benefit.

Existing administrators supply case ID, user/role, granted access and expiry; the counselor verifies these and policy version in s1. Missing fields and ambiguous care relationships are manually investigated in s3. No new free access inventory is assumed.

Test native exception reports first. Only 20 repeated manual rule comparisons are removed, not existing security runtime. s3-s4 retain investigation, correction and request writing. Unsupported access sources beyond this allowance lower savings.

The existing records administrator executes access changes in their own role; that existing work is excluded and not credited to the counselor. s4 approves the exact request before the actual send, which keeps its full small time. Ordinary author saves are ungated.
research_questions: Observe a real confidentiality review and separate rule comparison from care-context decisions.

incremental.description: Maintain access-rule mappings and check changed role definitions

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final access-change request and authorized administrator; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 20 rule-comparison points less 1.5 upkeep. A legacy access directory lacks current role mappings; compare only 4 points of explicit expired entries and retain other review manually: 4 minus 1.5 = 2.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Help clients express feelings and develop insight

steps.what: Read relevant client context before discussing feelings and relationships
Encourage clients to express feelings and develop insight into themselves and relationships

tasks.design: Retain client-context reading in the clinical application in {OTHER} and the therapeutic conversation. Native case access already presents the relevant record here; the counselor must personally understand it and support the client's expression.
tasks.previous_blocker: Therapeutic insight depends on trust and responsive human interaction.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case access provides context but does not remove therapeutic work.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising what a client is ready to express without imposing an interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Listen sensitively and help the client develop their own insight.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: helping clients express feelings and develop insight requires contextual understanding and a therapeutic relationship.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is this therapeutic encounter, with history reading retained. OTHER is the clinical case application. Required progress-note work is separately decomposed in 18484, not omitted from the role or duplicated here.

Before zero, inspect lookup, preparation, record and send boundaries. Native case access is already direct; documentation is assigned to 18484 once. Add any actual referral or client message separately when present.
No new transcript, insight score or progress log is introduced. No template removes fresh contextual reading or conversation, and no implementation or upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual additional written follow-up within the encounter
research_questions: Observe insight-focused counseling and allocate documentation once, checking for real separate sends.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 15 context-reading and 85 therapeutic-conversation points. A difficult relationship issue requires personal understanding; actual note writing is assessed separately rather than used to invent a saving here.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Counsel clients about dependencies and life changes

steps.what: Review current dependency, adjustment and change concerns in the client record
Counsel individuals or groups to overcome dependencies and make life changes

tasks.design: Keep dependency and adjustment counseling with the counselor, including the separately counted clinical-record review in {OTHER}. The existing native case view supports preparation but cannot perform the client's therapeutic change work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Counseling requires trust and context-sensitive professional response.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical records provide context without establishing a new removable operation in the encounter.
tasks.still_hard: Responding to ambivalence, setbacks and overlapping mental-health concerns.
tasks.human_edge: Work with the client at a safe and appropriate pace.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: counseling for dependencies and adjustment requires the clinician's own contextual preparation and live therapeutic interaction.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is counseling plus current-record review. OTHER is the clinical case application. Original records and progress notes belong to 18484 and are counted there once; no new free staff preparation is assumed.

Before zero, inspect preparation, lookup, note writing and sends. Current-record reading remains s1; documentation is separately decomposed in 18484. Native access is already direct and no repeated navigation baseline is assumed.
No new recording, client score or counseling activity log is added. Any actual referral or client message needs a separate counted action. No implementation or recurring upkeep is proposed.
unknowns: Actual additional referral or follow-up work
research_questions: Observe dependency-focused counseling and identify real preparation or sends beyond the counted review and separate notes.

incremental.description: No implementation or recurring upkeep proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Retain 10 record-review and 90 counseling points. Co-occurring concerns still need the counselor's own preparation and live response; documentation savings belong only to 18484.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Complete required client forms, diagnostic records and progress notes

steps.what: Verify client facts, counselor-authored diagnosis and actual progress and service details
Fill the actual mandated form with verified identity and service fields
Write the diagnostic record using only the counselor's own assessment

loop.purpose: Restate the counselor's diagnostic assessment without diagnosing
loop.input: Counselor-authored assessment and verified supporting facts
loop.output: Draft diagnostic narrative with source references
loop.check: Counselor checks diagnostic meaning, negation, uncertainty and that no symptom or diagnosis has been inferred
loop.stop: Unsupported diagnosis or symptom, missing assessment or two failed drafts returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native diagnostic fields come first; variable explanation of an existing assessment needs bounded restatement

steps.what: Write the required progress note from actual encounter facts

loop.purpose: Restate supplied progress and service facts
loop.input: Verified encounter facts and counselor-authored progress assessment
loop.output: Draft progress note with fact references
loop.check: Counselor checks attribution, chronology, omitted context, negation and every risk statement against actual facts
loop.stop: Invented risk, missing source or two failed drafts returns writing to manual
loop.why_not_simpler: Native progress fields come first; variable clinical narrative needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check all final paperwork, save ordinary records and authorize the exact required filing
outputs: checked retained records and approved filing

steps.what: Submit only the approved mandated form to its specified authorized agency
inputs: checked retained records and approved filing

tasks.design: Test native client-form defaults and clinical templates in {OTHER} first, then use bounded restatement for counselor-authored diagnostic and progress prose. Retain all clinical decisions, complete record checks and ordinary saves; a genuinely required agency filing remains its own gated action in {GOV_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Required paperwork repeats identity fields and clinical prose after assessment.
tasks.enabler_now: Native defaults and limited source-bound drafting can assist paperwork without diagnosing or inferring risk.
tasks.still_hard: Preserving clinical meaning and restricting what is disclosed outside care.
tasks.human_edge: Own diagnosis, progress interpretation and the accuracy of every record.
tasks.altitude: Less limited field entry and prose restatement with unchanged clinical accountability.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: clinical record templates can reuse verified identity fields and bounded drafts can restate clinician-authored assessments; complete clinical review remains necessary.

assumptions: Provisional boundary is actual client paperwork with an existing mandated agency form and its filing. National form requirements vary; no universal federal or state rule is asserted. If the actual form is retained internally, omit s6 and reweight without inventing a filing.

OTHER is the clinical case application. The counselor verifies client ID, encounter date, service, their own diagnosis, progress assessment, form version and allowed disclosure in s1. Capture, missing facts and clinical judgement remain counted; no free transcript or diagnostic producer is assumed.

Native defaults remove only 5 of 20 repeated identity/service-entry points. Diagnostic drafting removes 2 of 20 restatement points and progress drafting 4 of 20. All other writing, input, repair and full checks remain. Excess repair requires a lower estimate.

s5 ordinary case-record saves remain fully retained and ungated. Its separate authorization binds only the exact final mandated form, disclosure scope and agency destination for s6; edits void it. The actual filing retains its full small time and receipt handling.
Documentation for the counseling tasks is counted here once. No extra client-progress record is introduced.
unknowns: Actual mandated form and filing obligations
research_questions: Compare real forms and notes with source facts and count input, meaning corrections and filing time.

incremental.description: Maintain form mappings and inspect recurring clinical draft errors

approvals.approved_version: s5 exact final mandated form, allowed disclosure and authorized agency destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Remove 5 form-entry, 2 diagnostic-restatement and 4 progress-restatement points less 1.2 upkeep. A changed agency form and complex presentation leave only 0.8 identity-entry, 0.5 diagnostic-wording and 1 progress-wording points reusable: 2.3 minus 1.2 = 1.1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain therapeutic work, confidentiality decisions and diagnosis while reducing specific permission comparisons and actual paperwork repetition.
role.ambitious_version: No autonomous diagnosis, therapy or additional recording requirement is proposed.
